async def run(items, read):
    groups = list(batched(items, 1))
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*[read(item) for item in batch])
    saved: list[tuple] = list(batched(items, n=1))
    for batch in saved:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    for batch in list(batched(items, 1)):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    individual = [items[i:i+1] for i in range(0, len(items))]
    for batch in individual:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    wide = list(batched(items, 4))
    for batch in [items[i:i+1] for i in range(0, len(items))]:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
    for batch in wide:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*batch)
